quests.title: Start a sourdough starter
quests.description: Mix flour and water to begin a sourdough starter, and give it a name.

quests.title: Cook a dish from a story
quests.description: Recreate a meal described in a book, film or legend.

quests.title: Taste different honeys
quests.description: Taste honeys from different flowers or places and notice how different they are.

quests.title: Cook on a camping stove
quests.description: Take a small camping stove to a park or wild spot (where allowed) and cook a meal outdoors.

quests.title: Squeeze fresh lemonade
quests.description: Squeeze lemons into fresh lemonade and share it with someone.

quests.title: Eat stew from a bread trencher
quests.description: Bake a flat loaf and eat a stew from it the medieval way, then eat the plate.

quests.title: Walk backwards
quests.description: In a safe, open space, walk backwards for five minutes. Your brain will wake up.

quests.title: Try Nordic walking
quests.description: Borrow or buy walking poles and try Nordic walking for an hour.

quests.title: Learn a cartwheel
quests.description: On soft grass, practise until you can do a cartwheel, or get closer than yesterday.

quests.title: Swim a mile
quests.description: Swim a mile (about 1.6 km) in one session, resting at the wall as needed.

quests.title: Go ice skating
quests.description: Go ice skating at a rink, or on safe outdoor ice.

quests.title: Throw a frisbee in the park
quests.description: Spend some time throwing a frisbee in the park, trying one new throw.

quests.title: Try paddleboarding
quests.description: Rent a stand-up paddleboard and try to stay upright on the water.

quests.title: Run five kilometres
quests.description: Run or jog five kilometres without stopping, at whatever pace you like.

quests.title: Fifty push-ups through the day
quests.description: Do fifty push-ups across the day in small sets. Knees down is fine.

quests.title: Ride a horse
quests.description: Book a riding lesson or hack and ride a horse, like a knight on patrol.

quests.title: Try axe throwing
quests.description: Visit an axe-throwing venue and learn to hit the target.

quests.title: Roller-skate or skateboard
quests.description: Put on skates or step on a skateboard and practise in a safe, smooth place.

quests.title: Climb a thousand stairs
quests.description: Climb a thousand steps in one day, counting as you go.

quests.title: Bounce at a trampoline park
quests.description: Spend an hour at a trampoline park and try a trick.

quests.title: Climb a real mountain
quests.description: Hike to a summit higher than 500 metres above sea level.

quests.title: Tai chi in the park
quests.description: Follow a short tai chi routine outside in the morning air.

quests.title: Mobility routine for your spine
quests.description: Spend fifteen minutes on gentle movements for your back and neck.

quests.title: Hill sprints
quests.description: Sprint up a short hill three times, walking down to recover each time.

quests.title: Row a kilometre
quests.description: Row one kilometre on a rowing machine, or on the water, as steadily as you can.

quests.title: Take a historical fencing class
quests.description: Try a class in historical European martial arts and learn to wield a longsword.

quests.title: Dawn bike ride
quests.description: Ride your bike through empty streets or lanes just after dawn.

quests.title: Play capture the flag
quests.description: Gather a few people and play tag or capture the flag in a park.

quests.title: Work towards a pull-up
quests.description: Try a pull-up, or practise hanging and negative pull-ups to work towards one.

quests.title: Climb real rock with a guide
quests.description: Go rock climbing outdoors with a qualified guide or club.

quests.title: Dance for an hour
quests.description: Put on music and dance, non-stop, for a whole hour.

quests.title: Go sledging
quests.description: When snow falls, find a slope and go sledging (on a sledge, tray or bin bag).

quests.title: Swim a length underwater
quests.description: Take a big breath and try to swim a whole pool length underwater (safely, with a lifeguard present).

quests.title: Swing on the monkey bars
quests.description: Find a playground or fitness trail and cross the monkey bars.

quests.title: Advice to your younger self
quests.description: Write down three things you would tell your younger self.

quests.title: Walk a labyrinth
quests.description: Find a labyrinth (in a church, park or garden) and walk it slowly to the centre and back.

quests.title: Gaze into the fire
quests.description: Spend an evening watching a fire or candle flame and let your thoughts wander.

quests.title: List the people who shaped you
quests.description: Write down the people who shaped who you are, and one thing each gave you.

quests.title: Draw your ideal ordinary day
quests.description: Draw or describe your ideal ordinary day, from waking to sleeping.

quests.title: Keep a dream journal
quests.description: Keep a notebook by your bed and write down your dreams the moment you wake.

quests.title: Write about home
quests.description: Write about a place that feels like home, and why.

quests.title: Photograph this year
quests.description: Take a single photo that sums up this year of your life.

quests.title: Note a changed mind
quests.description: Write down one thing you have changed your mind about, and what changed it.

quests.title: Look at the year ahead from a hilltop
quests.description: Climb to a viewpoint and think about where you want to be a year from now.

quests.title: Read your old words
quests.description: Read old diaries, letters or messages and notice how you have grown.

quests.title: A day of noticing kindness
quests.description: Spend the day watching for acts of kindness around you, and list them at night.

quests.title: Meditate at sunrise
quests.description: Sit outside at sunrise and meditate for twenty minutes as the light grows.

quests.title: Write about a useful mistake
quests.description: Write about a mistake that taught you something you're glad to know.

quests.title: Make a vision board
quests.description: Cut out images and words that capture the life you want and arrange them on a board.

quests.title: Journal by candlelight
quests.description: Write in your journal by the light of a single candle.

quests.title: A silent hour
quests.description: Spend one hour in complete silence: no speaking, no music, no screens.

quests.title: Thank your body
quests.description: Write a thank-you note to your body for everything it carries you through.

quests.title: Visit an ancestor's resting place
quests.description: Visit the grave or memorial of an ancestor and think about their life.

quests.title: Consider your place among the stars
quests.description: On a clear night, look up and think about how far the light has travelled to reach you.

quests.title: Reread a book that changed you
quests.description: Pick up a book that once changed you and reread a favourite chapter.

quests.title: Gratitude walk
quests.description: Take a slow walk and name one thing you're grateful for with every hundred steps.

quests.title: Colour your year
quests.description: Colour a square for each month of the past year according to how it felt.

quests.title: Find a museum's quietest room
quests.description: Visit a museum and find its quietest room. Sit there for a while.

quests.title: Imagine a free year
quests.description: Write down what you would do with a whole year free of obligations.

quests.title: Walk part of a pilgrim's way
quests.description: Walk a section of an old pilgrimage route and think about those who walked it before you.

quests.title: Watch the tide come in
quests.description: Sit by the sea and watch the tide rise for an hour.

quests.title: Write your own proverb
quests.description: Distil something you have learned into a proverb a medieval sage would be proud of.

quests.title: Invite the neighbours for tea
quests.description: Invite your neighbours round for tea and cake.

quests.title: Join a folk singalong
quests.description: Find a pub singalong or folk session and join in the choruses.

quests.title: Cheer at a local match
quests.description: Go and cheer for a local team at a match, any sport, any level.

quests.title: Ask a question at a public talk
quests.description: Attend a public talk and ask the speaker a question at the end.

quests.title: Join a pick-up game
quests.description: Join a pick-up game of football, basketball or volleyball in the park.

quests.title: Host a film night
quests.description: Host a film night with snacks, blankets and a vote on what to watch.

quests.title: Join a book club
quests.description: Join a book club and go to its next meeting, even if you haven't finished the book.

quests.title: Go to a friendship meetup
quests.description: Go to a meetup or event designed for meeting new people.

quests.title: Throw a street party
quests.description: Organise a street party or neighbourhood gathering.

quests.title: Take part in a charity walk or run
quests.description: Sign up for and complete a charity walk, run or ride.

quests.title: Ask a shopkeeper about their trade
quests.description: Ask a local shopkeeper or craftsperson how they learned their trade.

quests.title: Play chess with a stranger
quests.description: Take a chess set to a park or café and play a game with a stranger.

quests.title: Join another community's celebration
quests.description: Attend a public cultural celebration held by a community other than your own.

quests.title: Host a craft afternoon
quests.description: Invite friends for an afternoon of making things together.

quests.title: Sing with a community choir
quests.description: Go along to a community choir rehearsal as a newcomer.

quests.title: Organise a tournament
quests.description: Organise a friendly tournament of a board game, video game or lawn game.

quests.title: Go to karaoke
quests.description: Go to karaoke with friends and sing at least one song.

quests.title: Be the quizmaster
quests.description: Write a quiz and host it for friends or family.

quests.title: Join a social sports session
quests.description: Join a walking football, social tennis or casual sports session.

quests.title: Greet everyone you pass
quests.description: On a walk, say good morning to everyone you pass. Count the smiles.

quests.title: See what's on at the community centre
quests.description: Visit a community centre and find out what goes on there.

quests.title: Host a barbecue
quests.description: Invite people to a barbecue and cook for them over the coals.

quests.title: Attend a community meeting
quests.description: Go to a local council, residents' or community meeting and listen.

quests.title: Swap books
quests.description: Take books to a book swap and come home with new ones.

quests.title: Play a tabletop role-playing game
quests.description: Join or run a tabletop role-playing session and become a hero for an evening.

quests.title: Talk to a stranger at a gallery
quests.description: At a gallery or museum, ask a stranger what they think of the work in front of you.

quests.title: Join a group bike ride
quests.description: Join a social group ride with a local cycling club.

quests.title: Bring a companion on your quest
quests.description: Invite someone to join you on today's adventure, whatever it is.

quests.title: See a puppet or shadow theatre
quests.description: Watch a traditional puppet or shadow theatre performance.

quests.title: Read a graphic novel
quests.description: Read a graphic novel from start to finish, lingering on the art.

quests.title: Hunt for gargoyles
quests.description: Visit a cathedral or old church and find every gargoyle and grotesque you can.

quests.title: Watch a dance performance
quests.description: See a ballet, contemporary or folk dance performance.

quests.title: Listen to a radio drama
quests.description: Listen to a radio drama or audio play with the lights down.

quests.title: Read a medieval poem aloud
quests.description: Read a passage of Chaucer, Sir Gawain or another medieval poem aloud, relishing the old words.

quests.title: Visit a folk-life museum
quests.description: Visit a museum of everyday life and see how ordinary people used to live.

quests.title: Watch a film from your birth year
quests.description: Watch a film released in the year you were born.

quests.title: Learn about an ancient civilisation
quests.description: Spend an hour learning about an ancient civilisation you know little about.

quests.title: Hear live jazz or blues
quests.description: Go to a jazz or blues gig, however small the venue.

quests.title: Walk a sculpture park
quests.description: Visit a sculpture park and walk among the works outdoors.

quests.title: Attend a film festival screening
quests.description: Go to a screening at a film festival and stay for the questions.

quests.title: Read an author from a faraway land
quests.description: Read a book by an author from a country you have never visited.

quests.title: See historic tapestries
quests.description: Visit a collection of tapestries or embroidered textiles and read the stories they tell.

quests.title: Go to the opera
quests.description: See an opera, live or screened in a cinema.

quests.title: Visit a historic library
quests.description: Visit a historic library reading room and admire the old books.

quests.title: Watch a film about a medieval craft
quests.description: Watch a documentary about a medieval craft: cathedral building, armouring, bookmaking.

quests.title: Learn the story behind a painting
quests.description: Choose a famous painting and learn the story behind it and the people in it.

quests.title: Go to a storytelling night
quests.description: Attend a storytelling evening where tales are told aloud.

quests.title: Visit an archaeological site
quests.description: Visit an archaeological site and imagine the lives uncovered there.

quests.title: Hear choirs in an old building
quests.description: Attend a choral concert or evensong in a historic building.

quests.title: Take part in a tea ceremony
quests.description: Take part in a tea ceremony or another traditional ritual from a different culture.

quests.title: Listen to medieval music
quests.description: Listen to music from the Middle Ages: troubadour songs, chant or estampies.

quests.title: Read a play aloud with friends
quests.description: Gather friends and read a play aloud, each taking parts.

quests.title: Visit a museum of instruments
quests.description: Visit a collection of musical instruments and find the strangest one.

quests.title: Learn a word of an old language
quests.description: Learn a word of Old English, Latin or Old Norse and use it today.

quests.title: See a comedy show
quests.description: Go to a comedy show, stand-up or improv, and laugh out loud.

quests.title: Watch a historical epic
quests.description: Watch a sweeping historical epic set in an age of castles and kings.

quests.title: Go left where you'd go right
quests.description: Wherever you'd normally turn right today, turn left, and see where it leads.

quests.title: Follow your first idea
quests.description: For one afternoon, do the first reasonable idea that pops into your head.

quests.title: Take the next departure
quests.description: Go to a station and take the next train or bus that fits your budget, wherever it goes.

quests.title: Let the library choose
quests.description: Pick a completely random quest from the Quest Library and do it today.

quests.title: Noon picnic wherever you are
quests.description: Wherever you are at noon, find the nearest patch of outdoors and have a picnic there.

quests.title: Let a friend plan your day
quests.description: Hand a friend control of your free day and do whatever they plan.

quests.title: Enter the third shop on the left
quests.description: Walk down a high street and go into the third shop on your left, whatever it sells.

quests.title: Make something from a random word
quests.description: Open a book at a random page, point at a word and make something inspired by it.

quests.title: Spin a globe for dinner
quests.description: Spin a globe or pick a random country and cook a dish from wherever your finger lands.

quests.title: Dance in the rain
quests.description: When it rains, go outside and dance in it for one song.

quests.title: Swap routines with someone
quests.description: Swap daily routines with a friend or housemate for a day.

quests.title: Go to a mystery event
quests.description: Find an event happening today that you know nothing about and go.

quests.title: Follow a bird
quests.description: Pick a bird and follow where it goes, at a respectful distance, for ten minutes.

quests.title: Step straight outside on waking
quests.description: The moment you get up, step outside and breathe the air before doing anything else.

quests.title: Speak in rhyme for an hour
quests.description: For one hour, try to say everything in rhyme. Friends will be baffled.

quests.title: Sit somewhere different
quests.description: Take a different seat everywhere you go today: at the table, on the bus, at work.

quests.title: Hold a leftovers feast
quests.description: Turn whatever is left in the cupboard into a feast and give each dish a grand name.

quests.title: Let the weather choose
quests.description: Look out of the window and do the first activity the weather suggests.

quests.title: Midnight snack expedition
quests.description: Walk to a late-night shop or bakery for a snack on a quiet evening.

quests.title: Take an unplanned day off
quests.description: If you can, take a day off with no plan at all and follow your nose.

quests.title: Turn an errand into a quest
quests.description: Give a boring errand a story, a map and a reward, and complete it in character.

quests.title: Talk to the next dog walker
quests.description: Say hello to the next person you see walking a dog and ask the dog's name.

quests.title: Post a card to yourself
quests.description: Buy a postcard wherever you are and post it to your own address.

quests.title: Photograph every bell you hear
quests.description: Each time you hear a bell today, take a photo of whatever is in front of you.

quests.title: Grab a bike share
quests.description: Hop on a shared bike or scooter and ride to somewhere you've never been.

quests.title: Breakfast for dinner
quests.description: Eat breakfast for dinner, and dinner for breakfast tomorrow if you dare.

quests.title: Open an atlas at random
quests.description: Open an atlas at a random page and spend twenty minutes learning about that place.

quests.title: Go out whatever the weather
quests.description: Whatever the weather is doing right now, go out in it for forty minutes.

quests.title: Learn a tune on a tin whistle
quests.description: Get a tin whistle and learn to play a simple folk tune.

quests.title: Sing or play in public
quests.description: Busk for five minutes, or sing a song somewhere people can hear.

quests.title: Listen to an artist you've never heard
quests.description: Listen to a whole album by an artist you have never heard of.

quests.title: Write a song about your town
quests.description: Write a song, however silly, about the place you live.

quests.title: Drum on buckets
quests.description: Turn buckets, pots and boxes into a drum kit and play a rhythm.

quests.title: Learn a sea shanty
quests.description: Learn all the verses of a sea shanty and sing it with gusto.

quests.title: Hear an organ recital
quests.description: Go to an organ recital in a church or hall and feel the music in your chest.

quests.title: Make a beat from street sounds
quests.description: Record sounds from your street and build them into a rhythm.

quests.title: Sing at full volume
quests.description: Sing your favourite song at full volume, in the shower or the car.

quests.title: Make a rain stick
quests.description: Make a rain stick or shaker from a tube, nails or pins and rice.

quests.title: Learn a song in another language
quests.description: Learn the words of a song in a language you don't speak and sing it.

quests.title: Hum a lullaby
quests.description: Hum or sing a lullaby, to a child, a pet, a plant or yourself.

quests.title: Give a disliked genre a chance
quests.description: Spend an hour with a genre of music you think you dislike, and find one song you like.

quests.title: Take a music lesson
quests.description: Book a single lesson on an instrument you have always wanted to play.

quests.title: Play music outdoors
quests.description: Take an instrument outside and play in a quiet park (considerately).

quests.title: Learn a rhythm from another culture
quests.description: Learn a drum rhythm from another musical tradition and tap it out.

quests.title: Make a rainy-day playlist
quests.description: Make a playlist especially for listening to while it rains.

quests.title: Sit in on a rehearsal
quests.description: Ask to sit in on a local orchestra, band or choir rehearsal.

quests.title: Write a birthday song
quests.description: Write an original birthday song for someone and sing it on the day.

quests.title: Learn the story of a song
quests.description: Pick a song you love and learn the story of how it was written.

quests.title: Play the glasses
quests.description: Fill glasses with different amounts of water and play a tune by tapping or rubbing them.

quests.title: Go to an open-air concert
quests.description: Attend a concert held outdoors, in a park, square or amphitheatre.

quests.title: Sing a round
quests.description: Learn a round like Sumer Is Icumen In and sing it with others.

quests.title: Make music with an app
quests.description: Try a music-making app or synthesiser and compose something short.

quests.title: Whistle a whole tune
quests.description: Practise whistling a whole tune from start to finish without a wrong note.

quests.title: Buy a record on instinct
quests.description: Visit a record shop and buy something because of its cover alone.

quests.title: Play a song to cheer someone
quests.description: Play or sing a song for someone who needs cheering up.

quests.title: Whittle a spoon
quests.description: Carve a wooden spoon from a green branch with a knife, slowly and safely.

quests.title: Make a candle
quests.description: Melt wax and pour or dip your own candle.

quests.title: Knit your first rows
quests.description: Learn to cast on and knit your first rows.

quests.title: Bind a book by hand
quests.description: Fold, stitch and bind a small notebook by hand, as monks once did.

quests.title: Stitch a leather pouch
quests.description: Cut and hand-stitch a small leather pouch for coins or treasures.

quests.title: Fold an origami crane
quests.description: Fold an origami crane, then another, and another.

quests.title: Make a foraged wreath
quests.description: Make a wreath from fallen greenery, twigs and seed heads.

quests.title: Throw a pot
quests.description: Take a pottery taster and throw a pot on the wheel.

quests.title: Make a friendship bracelet
quests.description: Knot a friendship bracelet and give it to someone.

quests.title: Build a birdhouse
quests.description: Build a wooden birdhouse and hang it where birds might nest.

quests.title: Make paper from scraps
quests.description: Pulp scrap paper and press it into new sheets of handmade paper.

quests.title: Embroider a small motif
quests.description: Embroider a small flower, star or initial on a piece of cloth.

quests.title: Weave a straw figure
quests.description: Weave a corn dolly or straw figure, an old harvest tradition.

quests.title: Launch a stick raft
quests.description: Build a small raft from sticks and string and float it on a stream.

quests.title: Make soap
quests.description: Make a bar of soap (melt-and-pour is fine) scented with herbs.

quests.title: Dye cloth with plants
quests.description: Dye a piece of cloth with onion skins, tea, beetroot or avocado stones.

quests.title: Make a mosaic
quests.description: Make a small mosaic from broken tiles, shells or pebbles.

quests.title: Build a model trebuchet
quests.description: Build a small working trebuchet or catapult from sticks and string.

quests.title: Seal a letter with wax
quests.description: Write a letter and seal it with wax, pressing your own mark into it.

quests.title: Carve a lantern
quests.description: Carve a lantern from a pumpkin, turnip or squash and light it at dusk.

quests.title: Make a hanging mobile
quests.description: Make a mobile from sticks, string and found objects and hang it by a window.

quests.title: Crochet a square
quests.description: Learn to crochet and make your first granny square.

quests.title: Weave a willow sculpture
quests.description: Weave willow or pliable sticks into a small sculpture outdoors.

quests.title: Forge something at a smithy
quests.description: Take a blacksmithing taster and forge a hook, nail or leaf from hot iron.

quests.title: Carve a display bow
quests.description: Carve a small decorative bow and arrows from sticks, for display only.

quests.title: Mend something beautifully
quests.description: Repair something with visible, decorative mending: bright stitches or golden glue.

quests.title: Cut a quill and write with it
quests.description: Cut a feather into a quill pen and write a line with ink.

quests.title: Leave coins to be found
quests.description: Leave a few coins in a vending machine or somewhere a stranger will find them.

quests.title: Buy a meal for someone in need
quests.description: Buy a meal or hot drink for someone who needs it.

quests.title: Praise a small business
quests.description: Write a warm, specific review for a small local business you love.

quests.title: Give away a book you loved
quests.description: Give a book you loved to someone who will enjoy it, with a note inside.

quests.title: Thank someone who's overlooked
quests.description: Thank a cleaner, driver or other worker whose work usually goes unnoticed.

quests.title: Bake for the neighbours
quests.description: Bake something and share it with your neighbours.

quests.title: Pick up litter on your walk
quests.description: Take a bag on your walk and pick up litter as you go.

quests.title: Read to someone in a care home
quests.description: Spend time at a care home reading aloud or simply talking with residents.

quests.title: Give blood
quests.description: Give blood, if you're able to, and help a stranger you'll never meet.

quests.title: Encourage someone who's struggling
quests.description: Send a message of genuine encouragement to someone going through a hard time.

quests.title: Stock a little free library
quests.description: Leave a book in a little free library or book-swap box.

quests.title: Walk a shelter dog
quests.description: Volunteer to walk a dog from an animal shelter.

quests.title: Support a cause
quests.description: Give a little time or money to a cause you believe in.

quests.title: Teach a child something
quests.description: Teach a child a skill: a knot, a card trick, a song, how to skim a stone.

quests.title: A day of chivalry
quests.description: For one day, practise old-fashioned courtesy: hold doors, give up seats, let people go first.

quests.title: Thank your postal worker
quests.description: Leave a thank-you note or treat for your postal worker, bin crew or delivery driver.

quests.title: Plant a tree
quests.description: Plant a tree, or join a tree-planting day, for people you'll never meet.

quests.title: Offer your skills for free
quests.description: Offer a skill for free: fix a bike, edit a CV, help with a computer.

quests.title: Make something for charity
quests.description: Knit, sew or make something to donate to a charity or shelter.

quests.title: Water for the wildlife
quests.description: Put out a shallow dish of water for birds, hedgehogs and bees.

quests.title: Tend a neglected corner
quests.description: Clean up and brighten a neglected corner of your neighbourhood.

quests.title: Share your umbrella
quests.description: When it rains, share your umbrella or shelter with someone caught without one.

quests.title: Pack a care kit
quests.description: Pack a kit of socks, snacks and toiletries for someone who is homeless.

quests.title: Forgive someone
quests.description: Choose to forgive someone in your heart, whether or not you tell them.

quests.title: Check on a quiet friend
quests.description: Check in on a friend who has gone quiet lately.

quests.title: Tip generously
quests.description: Tip generously today and thank the person properly.

quests.title: Carry someone's load
quests.description: Offer to carry someone's heavy shopping, pram or luggage up the stairs.

quests.title: Leap into a pile of leaves
quests.description: Rake or find a pile of autumn leaves and jump right into it.

quests.title: Build a snow lantern
quests.description: Stack snowballs into a hollow cone around a candle and light it at dusk.

quests.title: Study frost patterns
quests.description: On a frosty morning, look closely at the ice ferns on windows and car roofs.

quests.title: Mark the solstice
quests.description: Mark the longest or shortest day with a small ritual at sunset.

quests.title: Gather conkers and acorns
quests.description: Gather conkers, acorns or chestnuts and marvel at their shine.

quests.title: Find the first blossom
quests.description: Search your area for the first blossom of spring.

quests.title: Hold a harvest supper
quests.description: Cook a supper from the season's harvest and share it.

quests.title: Watch birds build nests
quests.description: In spring, watch quietly as birds gather twigs and moss for their nests.

quests.title: Swim on the first warm day
quests.description: When the first truly warm day arrives, go for a swim outdoors.

quests.title: Walk through a bluebell wood
quests.description: In spring, walk through a wood carpeted with bluebells or wildflowers.

quests.title: Stay up for the shortest night
quests.description: Around midsummer, stay up to watch the brief darkness and the early dawn.

quests.title: Build a snowman with character
quests.description: Build a snowman with a name, a personality and a costume.

quests.title: Make a season table
quests.description: Gather objects that capture this season and arrange them on a table or shelf.

quests.title: Watch the migration
quests.description: Watch for geese, swallows or other migrating birds passing overhead.

quests.title: Midwinter candle evening
quests.description: Spend a long winter evening by candlelight, with warm drinks and stories.

quests.title: Wassail an apple tree
quests.description: Follow the old custom: sing to an apple tree to wish it a good harvest.

quests.title: Plant bulbs for spring
quests.description: In autumn, plant bulbs that will surprise you in spring.

quests.title: Hunt for sea glass
quests.description: Search a beach for sea glass and treasures washed up by storms.

quests.title: Picnic under blossom
quests.description: Have a picnic beneath trees in blossom.

quests.title: Make a daisy chain
quests.description: Sit in a meadow or lawn and make a daisy chain crown.

quests.title: Crunch through the frost
quests.description: Walk across frosted grass early in the morning and listen to it crunch.

quests.title: Go to a harvest fair
quests.description: Go to a harvest festival, country show or county fair.

quests.title: Mark the equinox
quests.description: On the equinox, when day and night are equal, do something to celebrate balance.

quests.title: Watch the leaves turn from above
quests.description: Climb somewhere high to see a landscape of autumn colour.

quests.title: Eat outside on a summer evening
quests.description: Share a long outdoor meal on a warm summer evening.

quests.title: Make a May Day posy
quests.description: Gather a small posy of spring flowers and give it away, as on May Day of old.

quests.title: Light a seasonal bonfire
quests.description: Where permitted, light a bonfire to mark the turning of the season.
